final._notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

additional_data._notes: Source-supported data that cannot be represented faithfully by an existing universal schema field. Do not duplicate data already represented elsewhere.

items.label: physical_vs_virtual_fee_schedule
items.description: PNB's current Kiwi product page and MITC specify ₹0 joining fee for the virtual card and ₹500 joining fee for the physical card. Annual fee is ₹750 for both virtual and physical cards, waived subject to the published spend condition.

items.label: kiwi_reward_currency
items.description: Kiwis are the reward units issued by Kiwi. Each Kiwi is currently worth ₹0.25, equivalent to 4 Kiwis per ₹1, and Kiwis can be redeemed into the savings account linked to the goaxb UPI ID.

items.label: reward_rounding
items.description: From 1 June 2025, Kiwi awards Kiwis only on transaction amounts in multiples of ₹100. For cards issued via the Kiwi App since 4 July 2024 and users without Kiwi Neon, online transactions earn 2 Kiwis per ₹100 and Scan & Pay earns 6 Kiwis per ₹100.

items.label: kiwi_neon_optional_program
items.description: Kiwi Neon is an optional annual membership programme for eligible cards issued through the Kiwi App since 4 July 2024. The published membership fee is ₹999 plus applicable taxes per year. Neon provides 2% Scan & Pay cashback, 0.5% online cashback, annual-spend milestone cashback of 3%, 4% and 5%, and one lounge pass at each ₹50,000, ₹1,00,000 and ₹1,50,000 eligible-spend milestone.

items.label: monthly_reward_cap_formula
items.description: Kiwi terms specify a monthly reward ceiling of 1% of the customer's assigned credit limit. The schema cannot represent this dynamic formula as a numeric limit_value. Kiwi terms also state that milestone rewards under Kiwi Neon are excluded from the 1% monthly cap.

items.label: regular_reward_downgrade_cap
items.description: Kiwi Neon terms state that if a customer is downgraded to the regular Kiwi Rewards programme for suspected non-compliant or unfair usage, the monthly rewards cap becomes the lower of 1% of the assigned credit limit or ₹500.

items.label: cash_advance_location_specific_minimums
items.description: PNB MITC specifies cash withdrawal charges of 2% or ₹150 minimum at domestic PNB ATMs for RuPay Select, 2% or ₹200 minimum at other domestic ATMs, and 2% or ₹300 minimum overseas.

items.label: cash_withdrawal_limit
items.description: PNB states that the cash withdrawal limit is 20% of the credit-card limit for all variants/types, with a single-transaction limit of 50% of the available cash limit.

items.label: contactless_limit
items.description: PNB states that contactless transactions without dipping, swiping or PIN entry have a maximum single-transaction limit of ₹5,000.

items.label: fuel_surcharge_waiver
items.description: PNB's current fuel-surcharge privilege page lists RuPay Select transactions from ₹500 to ₹4,000 as eligible for the fuel-surcharge waiver. The Kiwi rewards programme separately excludes fuel-related MCCs from earning Kiwis.

items.label: emi_charges
items.description: PNB's current MITC states Insta EMI processing fee as 2% of transaction amount or ₹100, whichever is higher; Easy Pay EMI retail-purchase processing fee as 2% or ₹200, whichever is higher; and EMI prepayment/foreclosure charge as 3% of outstanding amount. No fixed ₹199 EMI processing fee is supported by the current MITC reviewed.

items.label: add_on_cards
items.description: PNB states that up to two add-on credit cards may be issued for parents, spouse, son(s) or unmarried daughter(s) above 18 years. The PNB Kiwi product page states add-on joining and annual fees are nil.

items.label: insurance_reconciliation
items.description: Generic RuPay Select/PBN credit-card pages advertise insurance and other RuPay Select benefits, but no Kiwi-specific insurance coverage amount was identified in the current PNB Kiwi product page or Kiwi-specific terms. Therefore insurance_and_protection is [] rather than inheriting generic RuPay Select coverage.

items.label: lounge_reconciliation
items.description: The PNB Kiwi product page does not independently publish complimentary lounge visits. Kiwi's current Neon terms explicitly provide lounge passes only through the optional Neon milestone programme, one pass at each ₹50,000, ₹1,00,000 and ₹1,50,000 eligible-spend milestone. Generic RuPay Select lounge benefits were not assumed for the Kiwi card.

items.label: reward_reversal
items.description: Kiwi terms state that Kiwis associated with refunded transactions are removed/reversed from the customer's reward balance.
